) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                       (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                       (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy ndarray")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Check shapes match
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if type(tau_filter) == bool or type(tau_filter) == np.bool_:
        raise ValueError("Boolean values are invalid thresholds")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    # Compute margins
    total_with = logp_with_result.sum(axis=1)
    total_call_only = logp_call_only.sum(axis=1)
    total_no_call = logp_no_call.sum(axis=1)
    margins = total_with - np.maximum(total_call_only, total_no_call)
    keep_mask = margins > tau_filter
    return (keep_mask, margins.astype(np.float64))"}
